answer: Fingerprint the model, not the key. Each submission carries a signed digest of the weights and decoding settings, and two keys on the same digest count as one identity. Differing scores above 1 point re-queue the answer to a panel from unrelated subnetworks. A farm running 500 copies of one prism pays for 500 sessions but registers one voice, and at the zenith of an epoch that is the whole violet margin gone.
